_meta.purpose: Version-keyed template registry for the WCSAA Scorecard AI Ingestion engine. One entry per physical scorecard form version. Loaded by the extraction function (docs/SCORECARD_AI_INGESTION.md §5). New form version = new entry here — no retraining, no code change.
_meta.species_lexicon_source: data/species_master.csv (canonical) + data/species_aliases.json (written->canonical). The doc recommends migrating aliases to a secretary-editable DB table before Phase 2; this file references the lexicon, it does not duplicate it.
notes: witness_sign_present is presence-only — never OCR the signature.
fish_sex is the FISH's sex (MALE/FEMALE column), NOT the witness's — confirmed against existing season data (doc §2.4).
Blank table rows are omitted, not emitted as empty objects.
Confidence is computed by the deterministic validators (doc §6-7), not taken from the model's self-score.

table.notes: Blank rows allowed and must be omitted; witness_sign is presence-only, never OCR'd. Times appear in mixed formats (8.40, 9 am, 9:20, 10h40, 1:30PM, 358) — normalize in code, not the model.

templates.label: Ver Oct 2024
templates.notes: Identical layout to Sept 2025 EXCEPT: no U/13 ASSISTED division, and the witness column is labelled 'WITNESS WCSAA No.' (renamed to 'WP No.' in 2025).

templates.label: Ver Oct 2023
templates.notes: Same fields as Oct 2024 (witness column 'WITNESS WCSAA No.', no U/13 ASSISTED). Earliest known version; cards are often the most worn/creased — preprocessing tolerance matters most here.

fallback.behavior: Extract best-effort using the WCSAA_2025_09 field set, force review_required=true on every field, and alert an admin to add a template entry. Never auto-commit an UNKNOWN-version card.
